instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case.
Role-based UI security: Hide HPP/Margin data and Supplier purchase cost from Kasir account; display PO status without price for Kasir.
Implement the Custom Indent Sheet Builder calculator with variables: Panjanga (Meter), Lengkung vs Lurus, Breakdown Upah Lengkung per meter, and total subtotal calculation.
Support dual warehouses (Mojopahit & Wahidin) with stock mutation transfer history.
Implement thermal receipt preview modal (80mm) and printable Surat Jalan A5/A4.
Ensure dot badge status in Sales History accurately reflects order state: Yellow (Proses Indent), Blue (Ready/Belum Dikirim), Orange (Antar Sebagian), Green (Close).
Use Sonner for toast notifications and Lucide React / Phosphor icons for modern industrial iconography.
